content.text:
All ByteSink usage is confined to the `com.google.common.io` package. I've verified every `openStream()` call site across those files.

Methods that call `openStream()` on a `ByteSink`/subclass receiver (main code, excluding android and tests):

- `ByteSink.openBufferedStream` — implicit-this call
- `ByteSink.write` — implicit-this call
- `ByteSink.writeFrom` — implicit-this call
- `ByteSink.AsCharSink.openStream` — calls `ByteSink.this.openStream()`
- `ByteSource.copyTo` — calls `sink.openStream()` on its `ByteSink` parameter

ANSWER: ByteSink.openBufferedStream, ByteSink.write, ByteSink.writeFrom, ByteSink.AsCharSink.openStream, ByteSource.copyTo
